title: Fix OT detail money formula to match HR 8-hour base-rate and highlight snapshot-vs-live differences
changes: Fix detail and monthly on-screen money: use claimed HR-equivalent hours x staff HR base rate (90 or 130), as Staff_Total and HR_OT do; prevent double-applying source segment rates
Add explicit read-only warning on Staff claim-detail whenever locked Export snapshot differs from current calculated claim; retain both figures instead of overwriting either
Keep previous v664 special-day quota, v663 OT event correction, v662 reopening, and all roster/physician features
Does not recalculate, delete or modify Supabase OT records, prior HR snapshots or carry-in history
The 8-hour discrepancies that arise from changed carry-in are not auto-resolved: admin must reconcile opening carry and source OT against the Export snapshot
